in_sanskrit.name: Sonoo
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Sweet Sound
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sonoo एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sonit' meaning 'sound', 'Sono' meaning 'sweet'. The name Sonoo is often given to girls born in the month of Jyestha (May-June) as it is believed to bring happiness, prosperity and good fortune to the child.
